status: exact tree-level normalization match in natural units; generic EFT constraint, not Spin(2,3) identification

conventions.units: hbar=c=1 for matching; masses and inverse couplings reported in GeV
conventions.spinOperator: Both kernels are expressed with Pauli vectors sigma rather than sigma/2.
conventions.contactTerm: excluded for separated macroscopic source and detector
conventions.overallSign: field and gamma5 conventions may reverse every g_p sign; absolute product constraints are unchanged

minimalBareCoefficientConditional.assumption: |c_e|=|c_n|=1/8 is provisionally used as a low-energy value; this is not derived after matching and running.
minimalBareCoefficientConditional.interpretation: A light 7 mm pole with minimal bare couplings must lie above this A normalization and requires enormous B; the experiment does not supply the mechanism making B radiatively stable.

naturalPlanckBenchmark.comparisonToReportedProductBound: more than 32 orders of magnitude below the coupling-product bound before also applying the overwhelming Planck-range Yukawa suppression

falsifiers: a coupling translation omits the fermion-mass factors implied by derivative axial coupling
Pauli-vector and spin-vector conventions are mixed without the corresponding factor of two
the reported experimental limit is geometry-corrected a second time without reconstructing the authors' likelihood
a bound on |c_e*c_n|/A is presented as a separate determination of A,c_e and c_n
the generic EFT constraint is presented as unique evidence for Spin(2,3)
